name: Oracle EBS Intelligence Hub Assistant
description: AI assistant for Oracle EBS consultants. Covers 7 capabilities: EBS Reports, SQL Advisor, Document Generator, EBS Academy, SQL Lab, Data Connect, and AI Chat. Built on IBM ICA Context Studio. CookCounty Team — IBM BoB Innovation Challenge 2025.

commands.name: ebs_reports
commands.description: Query the 26 EBS report templates. Find the right report, understand fields, filter by module/date/keyword, export data. Covers AP, AR, GL, PO, HRMS, INV, iExpense.

inputParameters.name: user_message
inputParameters.question: What would you like to know about EBS Reports?

inputParameters.name: context
inputParameters.question: Previous conversation context (leave blank for new conversation)

commands.name: sql_advisor
commands.description: Review Oracle EBS SQL for performance and compliance. Runs 27 Oracle EBS R12 coding standard checks. Formats SQL to Oracle style. Technical role only.

inputParameters.name: user_message
inputParameters.question: Describe what you want reviewed or type 'review', 'format', or 'performance'
inputParameters.defaultValue: Review my SQL for Oracle EBS compliance

commands.name: doc_generator
commands.description: Generate TDD (Technical Design Document) or FDD (Functional Design Document) for Oracle EBS reports. Follows CCG Cook County template standards. 3-4 hours → 2 minutes. Technical role only.

inputParameters.name: doc_type
inputParameters.question: Which document type do you need?

inputParameters.name: report_name
inputParameters.question: Enter the report name (e.g. AP Invoice Summary, GL Trial Balance)

inputParameters.name: user_message
inputParameters.question: Any additional details for the document? (optional)
inputParameters.defaultValue: Generate the document with all standard sections

commands.name: ebs_academy
commands.description: Learn Oracle EBS R12 concepts across 15 structured modules. Covers all roles: AP Clerk, AR Analyst, GL Accountant, Buyer, Developer, DBA, Project Manager. Includes SQL examples and process flows.

inputParameters.name: user_message
inputParameters.question: What Oracle EBS topic would you like to learn about?

inputParameters.name: module_name
inputParameters.question: Which Oracle module? (e.g. AP, AR, GL, PO, HRMS, INV, iExpense, General)

inputParameters.name: user_role
inputParameters.question: Your role on the engagement? (e.g. AP Clerk, Developer, DBA, Project Manager)

commands.name: sql_lab
commands.description: Find, explain, or generate Oracle EBS SQL queries from a library of 500+ queries across 12 categories. AI Prompt-to-SQL converts plain English to Oracle SQL. Technical role only.

inputParameters.name: user_message
inputParameters.question: Describe the SQL query you need in plain English, or paste a query to explain

commands.name: data_connect
commands.description: Help with importing Excel/CSV files into EBS Reports. Guides column mapping, DB simulation setup, and Live DB Proxy configuration. Available to all roles.

inputParameters.name: user_message
inputParameters.question: What do you need help with? (e.g. upload Excel, column mapping, simulate data, connect to DB)

commands.name: ai_chat
commands.description: General Oracle EBS AI assistant. Ask anything about Oracle EBS R12 — reports, SQL, processes, terminology, roles, troubleshooting. Powered by IBM ICA Context Studio with 17,000+ chars of EBS knowledge.

inputParameters.name: user_message
inputParameters.question: Ask me anything about Oracle EBS R12...

inputParameters.name: context
inputParameters.question: Previous conversation context (leave blank for new conversation)

parameters.name: ICA_BASE_URL
parameters.description: IBM ICA MCP Gateway base URL — from backend/.env ICA_WORKFLOW_URL

parameters.name: CAPABILITY
parameters.description: Active capability tab: reports, sql_advisor, doc_generator, academy, sql_lab, data_connect, general

parameters.name: USER_ROLE
parameters.description: User's access role: employee (3 tabs) or technical (all 7 tabs)

credentials.note: Use MCP_BEARER_TOKEN from backend/.env — 90-day validity token from ICA MCP Gateway
